exposure: Large for gestational age infant in first delivery
cohort: 7683 women in Sweden who had a previous caesarean delivery and attempted a vaginal birth in their second delivery between 2001 and 2007
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of uterine rupture between single-layer and double-layer closure of the uterus.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the rate of uterine rupture between single- and double-layer closure of the uterus during vaginal birth after one prior cesarean delivery.
